Conventional platforms block access based on geography, not merit. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle follow suit, leaving creators with no payment processing, no automatic delivery, and no [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solana-payments-digital-products-what-actually-how-works-4|COREMERCH guide to solana]]-payments-digital-products-stripe-3|The Full]] they own. The real problem isn’t payment rejection—it’s platform dependency. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solves this by replacing rented tools with owned architecture. No subscriptions. No geographic restrictions. No platform risk. This isn’t a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure designed for regions where financial isolation is a fact of life. Here’s the side-by-side analysis of your actual options.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Paddle offer simplicity—until they don’t. They handle hosting, payments, and delivery in exchange for fees and control. The moment your country is restricted, you lose access to your own store. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, deploys tools you own: GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for logic, Supabase for storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. No platform locks you in. No subscriptions. No geographic blocks. The tradeoff? You manage deployment. The reward? Permanent infrastructure. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit provides all blueprints and templates for $197. You own the stack. They have no access after delivery. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s a structural shift from renting to owning.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe, PayPal, and their clones block entire countries based on compliance costs or political risk. Nigeria, Zimbabwe, and Venezuela are frequent targets. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this by using decentralized tools. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers operate globally without geographic restrictions. NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC, no buyer accounts, and no country blocks. The payment network itself (BSC, Solana, TRON) becomes the settlement layer—not a platform. This architecture doesn’t ask permission. It routes around restrictions. The tradeoff? You must educate buyers on crypto payments. The reward? No platform can shut you down. COREMERCH’s stacks are pressure-tested in Zimbabwe against currency collapse and financial isolation. They work where conventional tools fail.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms charge 5-10% per transaction, hold funds for days, and reverse payments on whims. Crypto payments via NOWPayments charge 0.5% with no holds. Funds settle directly to your wallet the moment the blockchain confirms—usually under 60 seconds. Recommended networks like BSC and TRON cost under $0.10 per transaction. The tradeoff? Volatility risk if you don’t convert to stablecoins. The reward? Instant, irrevocable payments with no platform interference. Sovereign stacks eliminate middlemen. You pay a one-time $197 for COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit and own the infrastructure forever. No recurring fees. No revenue share. No platform risk. This is what financial sovereignty looks like.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure works where Stripe fails.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms own your customer data, product files, and payment history. They can suspend your account or change terms overnight. Sovereign infrastructure puts you in control. GitHub Pages hosts your store. Supabase stores your orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers your files. NOWPayments handles payments. Each component is modular and replaceable. Automation happens via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script—logic you own. The tradeoff? You configure the stack once. The reward? No platform can delete your business. COREMERCH deploys your stack in 48 hours, loads your products, and hands over the keys. After that, it’s yours. No backdoors. No dependencies. Just infrastructure you own.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a restricted country and need to sell digital products today, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only structural solution. Conventional platforms offer convenience until they don’t. Sovereign stacks offer permanence. Choose the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) if you’re launching 3 products and need GitHub Pages + Apps Script deployed fast. Choose the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) if you need Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and end-to-end testing. For full control, buy the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and deploy all stacks yourself. The tradeoff is clear: manage deployment for lifetime ownership. The reward is clearer: no platform can lock you out. This isn’t a workaround. It’s infrastructure built for the people Stripe left behind.

Conventional tools like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Paddle block access based on geography, leaving you with no payment processing or delivery. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) for GitHub Pages + Apps Script or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for Cloudflare Workers + Supabase. 2. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all blueprints and templates. 3. Deploy your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 4. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 5. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 6. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 7. Load your products and test end-to-end delivery. 8. Launch your store with full ownership and no platform dependencies.
